scenes.title: Over 100 investors said no.
scenes.say: Over one hundred investors said no.

scenes.label: investors rejected Melanie Perkins while she raised money for Canva
scenes.say: Melanie Perkins pitched Canva to more than a hundred investors. It took her about three years to raise funding.

scenes.label: Canva's valuation in a 2021 funding round
scenes.say: In twenty twenty one, Canva raised money at a forty billion dollar valuation.

scenes.title: A no is not the end.
scenes.say: A no is not the end. Follow for more founder stories.
